plugins.name: litigation-legal
plugins.description: Manages the litigation portfolio — matters, deadlines, holds, demands, outside counsel — and does the work: claim charts (patent and civil), chronologies, depo prep, privilege logs, brief drafting. Adapts to how you work litigation: in-house, firm, or solo.

skills.name: brief-section-drafter
skills.description: Draft a brief section in house style, consistent with the case theory — every fact cited, every case checked, every argument tied to the theory. Use when the user says "draft the [section]", "write the statement of facts", "argument section on [issue]", or needs a first draft of a brief section.
headings: Witness statements for England & Wales — PD 57AC
skills.description_zh: 按律所文风及案件论证路线起草法律书状指定章节，逐项引用事实、核查判例，并将论点关联整体案件主张。

skills.name: chronology
skills.description: Build or update a chronology from declared document sources and uploads — dated events extracted, de-duped, and tagged by significance per the matter theory. Use when the user asks to build a chronology or timeline from a production or matter file, says "chron from the production" or "what happened when", or needs a working, statement-of-facts, or witness-specific timeline.
headings: Step 0: Privilege gate (runs first, every time)
Step 5: Tag significance — per case theory
skills.description_zh: 从指定文档和上传材料构建或更新案件时间线，提取带日期事件、去重并按案件主张标记重要性，支持工作、事实陈述及特定证人时间线。

skills.name: claim-chart
skills.description: Build or review an element chart — a patent claim chart (infringement, invalidity, or review) or a civil element chart for any cause of action or defense — with every cell pin-cited and gap detection as the priority output. Use when the user asks for a claim chart, element chart, proof chart, infringement or invalidity contention, element-by-element mapping, or asks "what are we missing to prove [claim]".
headings: A CHART IS A DRAFT, NOT A FINDING OR A CONTENTION
Step 4: Dependent claims — execute, don't gesture
Step 4.5: DOE supplements — execute, don't gesture
skills.description_zh: 制作或审查专利侵权、无效或其他民事诉因和抗辩的要素表，每个单元格提供精确引文，重点识别逐项证明缺口。

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: House cold-start for the litigation plugin — branches by role (in-house, firm associate, solo) and side (plaintiff, defense, both), captures risk calibration, landscape, and house style, and writes the practice profile CLAUDE.md. Use on a fresh install, when the user wants to set up or redo the practice profile, or to re-check available integrations.
headings: Check for the shared company profile
After the user picks quick or full
Part 0: Who's using this + role routing
Which side do you mostly represent?
skills.description_zh: 初次设置诉讼插件档案，按公司法务、律所律师或独立执业及原被告立场分支采集风险、业务环境和文风，写入CLAUDE.md并检查可用集成。

skills.name: customize
skills.description: Guided customization of your litigation practice profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust practice role, side (plaintiff / defense / mixed), risk calibration, landscape, house style, escalation contacts, severity vocabulary, or matter workspace paths. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
skills.description_zh: 逐项定制诉讼执业档案，无需重做全部初始访谈，支持角色、诉讼立场、风险尺度、业务环境、文风、升级联系人、严重程度词汇及案件工作区路径。

skills.name: demand-draft
skills.description: Draft a demand letter from a completed intake, gated on a privilege / FRE 408 / waiver / admission checklist, with a .docx output, post-send checklist, and an offer to create a matter. Use when the user says "draft the demand", "write the [type] letter", or has a finished demand intake ready to turn into a sendable draft.
headings: Step 2: Soft templates (used only when no seed doc)
skills.description_zh: 根据已完成的资料采集起草要求函，先检查保密特权、FRE 408、权利放弃和承认事项，输出DOCX、发送后清单及案件创建选项。

skills.name: demand-intake
skills.description: Pre-drafting context gathering for a demand letter — parties, facts, basis, leverage, BATNA, and privilege filters — written to a structured intake.md the demand-draft skill reads. Use when the user wants to prep a demand letter, run intake before drafting, or capture context for a payment demand, breach/cure notice, cease-and-desist, employment separation, or preservation demand.
headings: Posture for this matter (ask FIRST, before the core)
Strategic — asked if material, or if `--full`
skills.description_zh: 起草要求函前收集当事人、事实、依据、谈判筹码、最佳替代方案和保密筛选信息，写入供要求函技能读取的intake.md，支持催款、违约补救、停止侵害、离职及保全要求。

skills.name: demand-received
skills.description: Triage an inbound demand letter — extract fields, cross-check the portfolio, assess merit, present response options with a recommendation, and hand off to matter-intake or demand-intake if escalation is warranted. Use when the user says "we got a demand letter", "triage this demand", or shares an incoming demand to evaluate.
skills.description_zh: 评估收到的要求函，提取字段、对照案件组合、分析依据并提出应对选项与建议，需要升级时移交案件登记或要求函资料采集技能。

skills.name: deposition-prep
skills.description: Build a deposition outline for a witness — pull their documents from the eDiscovery platform, organize topics around the case theory, and surface impeachment material. Use when the user says "depo prep for [witness]", "build a depo outline", or "prepare for [name]'s deposition".
headings: Witness statements for England & Wales — PD 57AC
Step 1a: Witness posture — branch before drafting questions
skills.description_zh: 从电子证据发现平台取得证人相关文件，围绕案件论证组织证言录取提纲，并突出可用于质疑证人可信度的材料。

skills.name: legal-hold
skills.description: Issue, refresh, release, or report on legal holds — drafts the hold notice as .docx, updates legal_hold fields in _log.yaml, and calendars the next refresh. Use when the user says "issue a hold", "refresh hold", "release hold", or asks for a portfolio-wide hold status report.
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 创建、更新、解除或报告诉讼资料保全要求，生成DOCX通知、更新_log.yaml中的legal_hold字段，并安排下一次刷新。

skills.name: matter-briefing
skills.description: Deep briefing on one matter — current posture, what's changed, next deadline, open questions, and a risk re-assessment check, ready before a GC update or outside counsel call. Use when the user says "brief me on [matter]", "where are we on [matter]", or needs a read on a specific matter.
headings: Close with the next-steps decision tree
skills.description_zh: 为总法律顾问汇报或外部律师沟通准备单案深度简报，汇总当前状态、变化、下一期限、未决问题及风险复评。

skills.name: matter-close
skills.description: Close a matter — capture outcome, final exposure, and lessons, then archive it out of the active portfolio without deleting the record. Use when the user wants to close a matter, says "[matter] is done", or needs to record a settlement, dismissal, judgment, withdrawal, or consolidation outcome.
skills.description_zh: 记录案件结果、最终风险敞口和经验，将和解、撤诉、判决或合并等已结束案件移出活跃组合并归档保留记录。

skills.name: matter-intake
skills.description: Intake a new matter — uniform questions covering identification, conflicts, source, risk triage, materiality, outside counsel, owners, legal hold, and key dates; writes matter.md and history.md and appends a structured row to _log.yaml. Use when the user says "new matter", "intake this matter", or wants to bring a new matter into the portfolio.
skills.description_zh: 通过统一问题登记新案件，采集身份、冲突、来源、风险、重大性、外部律师、负责人、资料保全与关键日期，写入matter.md、history.md和_log.yaml。

skills.name: matter-update
skills.description: Append a dated event to a matter's history file and refresh the log row — captures new developments, status changes, risk re-assessments, deadline shifts, and settlement authority changes. Use when the user wants to log an update on a matter, note a development, or record a status change against the portfolio.
skills.description_zh: 向案件历史追加带日期事件并刷新组合日志，记录新进展、状态、风险复评、期限变化及和解授权变化。

skills.name: matter-workspace
skills.description: Manage matter workspaces for multi-client practices — create, list, switch, close, or detach the active matter. Use when the user wants to create a new matter workspace, switch the active matter, list matters, archive a matter, or work at practice-level only without an active matter.
headings: Active matter is in the practice CLAUDE.md
skills.description_zh: 管理多客户执业的案件工作区，创建、列出、切换、关闭或解除当前案件，支持归档及仅在执业层面工作。

skills.name: oc-status
skills.description: Generate weekly status-request email drafts to outside counsel across the active portfolio — markdown per matter, plus Gmail drafts when the MCP is available. Use when the user asks for OC status requests, weekly outside counsel check-ins, or wants per-matter status emails drafted from the portfolio log.
headings: Send gate (closing note on every draft)
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 根据活跃案件组合日志，为外部律师生成每周进展询问邮件草稿，逐案输出Markdown；可用Gmail MCP时同时创建邮件草稿。

skills.name: portfolio-status
skills.description: Roll up the portfolio from _log.yaml — risk distribution, upcoming deadlines, stale matters, materiality totals, stage distribution, and flagged anomalies. Use when the user asks "where do we stand", "how many open matters", or wants a portfolio rollup or status across all active matters.
headings: Close with the next-steps decision tree
What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 从_log.yaml汇总活跃案件组合，展示风险分布、临近期限、久未更新案件、重大性总量、阶段分布及标记异常。

skills.name: privilege-log-review
skills.description: First-pass privilege log review — make the obvious privilege calls and flag the hard ones for attorney review without making close calls. Use when the user says "review the privilege log", "priv log", "check privilege on these docs", or has a log to QA before production.
headings: Record fidelity — pinpoints and citation coverage
Step 0: Research the forum's privilege-log rules
Confidently privileged (✅) — keep designation, no flag
Confidently not privileged (❌) — recommend remove, but note the assessment
skills.description_zh: 初步审查保密特权清单，对明显事项作分类，将难判断项目交律师评审，支持材料交付前质量检查。

skills.name: subpoena-triage
skills.description: Triage a subpoena served on the company — classify it, analyze scope/burden/privilege, cross-check the portfolio, and produce an objections framework, compliance plan, and deadline calendar. Use when the user says "we got a subpoena", "served with a subpoena", or shares a subpoena, CID, or third-party document request to evaluate.
skills.description_zh: 评估送达公司的传票、CID或第三方文件请求，分类并分析范围、负担和保密特权，对照案件组合，形成异议框架、履行计划及期限日历。
